title: OpenCanvas
description: OpenCanvas operations (OPS-01): traffic, collaboration, persistence, host callbacks, exports, process, security. Source: deploy/monitoring/build-dashboard.py.

panels.title: Ready nodes
panels.description: Nodes whose /readyz answers 200 (oc_ready): database reachable and not draining.

panels.title: Scrape up
panels.description: Targets Prometheus scraped successfully (up). Below the node count = a node is down.

panels.title: Draining
panels.description: Nodes draining after SIGTERM (oc_draining). Non-zero during deploys only.

panels.title: Restarts (1 h)
panels.description: Process restarts in the last hour (changes of process_start_time_seconds).

panels.title: Uptime (youngest)
panels.description: Seconds since the most recent process start.

panels.title: HTTP 5xx ratio
panels.description: Share of HTTP responses with a 5xx status over 5 min (oc_http_responses_total). 501 from /v1/export/pdf without Gotenberg counts here.

panels.title: HTTP responses / s by status class
panels.description: oc_http_responses_total{code}. WebSocket upgrades count as 1xx (101).

panels.title: Ready / draining per node
panels.description: oc_ready and oc_draining per instance.

panels.title: Open rooms
panels.description: oc_rooms_active, all nodes.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Open WebSocket connections (oc_connections_active), all nodes.

panels.title: Launches / min
panels.description: Sessions started per minute (oc_launches_total).

panels.title: Edits / s
panels.description: Accepted document updates per second (oc_updates_total).

panels.title: Edit latency floor p95
panels.description: p95 of one WAL append (oc_wal_append_seconds). Every accepted edit waits for it before fan-out, so it is the floor of sync latency. Alert above 50 ms.

panels.title: Rejected edits / s
panels.description: Updates refused by the server (read-only role, malformed): oc_updates_rejected_total.

panels.title: Sync latency floor (WAL append) p50 / p95 / p99
panels.description: oc_wal_append_seconds. There is no end-to-end edit latency histogram (see gaps).

panels.title: Presence fan-out / s
panels.description: Awareness frames fanned out, and those parked because a room inbox was full.

panels.title: Saves / min
panels.description: Commits the host acknowledged (oc_saves_total).

panels.title: Save errors / min
panels.description: Failed saves, each retried with backoff (oc_save_errors_total).

panels.title: Conflicts (1 h)
panels.description: Host answered 409/412; the conflict policy (copy or reload) ran (oc_save_conflicts_total). With on_conflict=copy each is a conflict copy.

panels.title: Commit outbox
panels.description: Commits waiting for the host (oc_commit_outbox_pending). Whole store: every node of a cluster reports the same value, so this is max, not sum.

panels.title: Mean WAL batch
panels.description: Updates per WAL batch (oc_wal_rows_total / oc_wal_batches_total).

panels.title: Schema warnings (1 h)
panels.description: Unknown blocks/attrs kept on read or write (oc_schema_warnings_total).

panels.title: Commit outbox depth
panels.description: Should drain to 0. Growing = the host is not accepting saves.

panels.title: Host call p95 by host and operation
panels.description: oc_host_callback_seconds{host,op}: load, save, copy, access, members, notify.

panels.title: Host calls / s by result
panels.description: oc_host_callbacks_total{host,op,result}; result is ok, conflict, 4xx, 5xx, unreachable or error.

panels.title: Host error ratio by host
panels.description: 5xx, unreachable and error over all calls, 5 min.

targets.expr: (sum by (host) (rate(oc_host_callbacks_total{job=~"$job",namespace=~"$namespace",instance=~"$instance",host=~"$host",result=~"5xx|unreachable|error"}[5m])) or sum by (host) (rate(oc_host_callbacks_total{job=~"$job",namespace=~"$namespace",instance=~"$instance",host=~"$host"}[5m])) * 0) / sum by (host) (rate(oc_host_callbacks_total{job=~"$job",namespace=~"$namespace",instance=~"$instance",host=~"$host"}[5m]))

panels.title: Webhook deliveries / s by result
panels.description: oc_webhook_deliveries_total{host,result}; result is ok, retry, rejected (3xx/4xx), gave_up (out of attempts) or refused (URL off the callback origin).

panels.title: Webhook attempt p95 by host
panels.description: oc_webhook_delivery_seconds{host}: time of one POST to the webhook URL (10 s timeout).

panels.title: Webhooks dropped / s by host
panels.description: Events that will not be delivered: given up, refused by the receiver, or not allowed.

panels.title: Exports / s by format and result
panels.description: oc_exports_total{format,result}.

panels.title: Export p95 by format
panels.description: oc_export_seconds{format}. PDF includes the Gotenberg round trip.

panels.title: PDF errors (1 h)
panels.description: PDF exports that failed: Gotenberg down or erroring, or no OC_PDF_RENDERER (501).

panels.title: Resident memory
panels.description: process_resident_memory_bytes (Linux /proc). Compare with the container limit (chart default 1 GiB).

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Cores used (rate of process_cpu_seconds_total).

panels.title: File descriptors
panels.description: Each WebSocket holds one; raise nofile above the connection count.

panels.title: Rejected launches by code
panels.description: oc_launches_rejected_total{code}: bad signature, expired, replayed, unknown host…

panels.title: Refused edits and host 4xx
panels.description: Edits the server refused (role enforcement) and host calls answered 4xx (expired callback token, revoked access).

options.content: OpenCanvas exports no cluster or Redis series yet (relay frames, lease ownership, Redis latency are gaps in docs/13). In cluster mode the panels above sum over nodes; `oc_commit_outbox_pending` is store-wide (max). Scrape Redis with [redis_exporter](https://github.com/oliver006/redis_exporter) and MariaDB with mysqld_exporter.
